snippet.title: Isekat - Official Kickstarter Trailer
snippet.description:
Crushed by a computer, my beloved kitten is transported to a fantasy world where its typing skills save the kingdom!

Isekat is a typing game where you play the role of an unfortunate kitten from our world who unexpectedly dies and wakes up in a fantasy world of swords, magic and anthromorphic animal people! 
Armed with a magical laptop-like relic, the instinctive affinity of a cat with keyboards, and your typing fingers, you venture forth as a kitten, the one sole hope of the Cat Kingdom.

Out now on Kickstarter! We would really appreciate your support for the last stretch of development!
http://kck.st/3SCA0eJ

Follow us on our socials for updates!
